capabilities: View and edit CSV files as tables, cards, kanban boards and dashboards
Render scatter, line and bar charts with best-fit lines and formula overlays
Embed live CSV views and charts in notes via csv-view, csv-chart, csv-tasks and csv-add blocks
Filter rows with per-file condition rules without deleting data
Push rows to Anki as flashcards
disambiguation: Not a database or spreadsheet app; it edits plain CSV files in place with no shadow copies.
extras: Not yet in the community store; install via BRAT or manually from releases. States no telemetry or network calls except the optional Anki sync to localhost.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, edit or visualize CSV files inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Requires the AnkiConnect add-on and the Anki desktop app running

requires.name: Anki desktop with the AnkiConnect add-on

summary: CSV viewer and editor that opens .csv files as tables, cards, kanban, charts, dashboards, timelines, budget trackers and maps, saving edits back to the file.
